question: Which of the following States hosted the fourth edition of the Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Haryana__ will host the 4th Khelo India Youth Games. 
 
• Khelo India Youth Games is scheduled to take place after the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.
 
• The Games will be held at Panchkula in Haryana.
 
• This was announced by Sports Minister Kiren Rijiju and Haryana Chief Minister Manohar Lal Khattar.
 
• Usually, the Khelo India Youth Games take place in January every year. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Haryana: 

 
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 10.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 5.
 
• National Parks - Kalesar National Park, Sultanpur National Park.
 
• Dams - Kaushalya Dam (Yamuna River), Ottu barrage (Ghaggar River), Anagpur Dam (Hakra River).
